name: vanish-from-sight-is-refused-during-your-own-main-phase
notes: Timing restrictions ('Activate this card only during ...') were either absent or compared against phase codes the engine never reports (the end-phase opportunity window runs as BEOP, not END), and the $cardActivatedPrereqs table they were generated into was never consulted. Prereqs now live in Custom/GeneratedAbilityOverrides.php and are enforced by ActivationBlockedBeforeAnnounce / CanActivateCardForSelection.

rulesClauses: Activate this card only during an opponent's recollection phase.

engineBug.summary: Vanish from Sight (also Attune with Flames, Hemorrhaged Intimidation, Ingress of Sanguine Ire, Stand Fast) had no timing restriction at all.
